visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard, wearing a black baseball cap and a brown utility jumpsuit, stands in a crowded exhibition hall. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. The background shows various booths and many blurred people moving. (2) The scene cuts to archival, grainy video footage from 2019. A younger version of the same man is in a workshop setting, standing next to a massive blue industrial robot arm. The lighting is dim compared to the first scene. (3) The video transitions back to the bright exhibition hall. The man stands next to a sleek, silver, and compact robotic arm mounted on a mobile cart. (4) Close-up shots of the robotic arm's welding head moving with precision over a metal workpiece. Graphic overlays indicate 'AI' and brand logos. The background is a clean, white exhibition space. (5) Fast cuts show the robot in various industrial environments, such as a shipyard and a construction site, performing tasks on large structures. (6) Close-up shots focus on the quality of the welds, showing smooth, consistent metal beads on a steel joint. (7) The man returns to the screen, standing in front of a large neon sign that reads 'Taiwan Innotech Expo.' He walks toward the camera, gesturing with three fingers, and then gestures toward the exhibition entrance behind him.

Sections of the video show archive footage of a cluttered workshop and outdoor construction sites featuring large cranes and airport terminal structures.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a fast rate, exhibiting positive valence and high arousal. A synthetic EDM background music track with a clear 4/4 beat at roughly 128 BPM plays concurrently. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a new phase as the speaker reflects on the past; the vocal tone becomes slightly more narrative but maintains intensity. (3) A digital 'bling' sound effect punctuates the mention of AI, followed by a slight swell in the music's high-frequency brightness. (4) Short, percussive impact SFX are synchronized with the appearance of text overlays on the screen. The music continues with a steady, driving rhythm. (5) As the speaker invites the audience to the expo, his vocal pitch rises slightly in an inviting gesture. The BGM maintains its tempo until a final hard cut at the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Historical Comparison -> Technological Solution -> Case Studies -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the evolution of welding technology from complex 2019 machinery to modern AI-driven, easy-to-use robotic arms, and to promote the Taiwan Innotech Expo where these technologies are on display.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the creator actively promoting the 'Taiwan Innotech Expo' and showing 'DOIT' (MOEA) branding throughout while inviting viewers to attend.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality social media tech vlog utilizing fast cuts and energetic delivery to maintain engagement. Strong integration of physical site footage with expo floor demonstrations.
